text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to establish an accessible loading zone on the east side of Gladstone Avenue, between Hallam Street and Shanly Street. The loading zone will provide curb-side access for Wheel-Trans vehicles for picking up or dropping off patrons. The loading zone is required from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. daily and will result in the loss of two on-street parking spaces during this period and no impact to overnight permit parking.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone operating from 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. daily on the east side of Gladstone Avenue, from a point 39 metres south of Hallam Street to a point 11 metres further south.
